title: IronFurnacesNeoForge issue #14: Server crashes when the redstone comparator button is clicked
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (Apache-2.0) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Naxomega]
When I click the redstone comparator button, the server crashes, and crashes over and over again at each start.
Steps : 
Start the server
Connect to the server
Place a modded furnace
Click the redstone comparator button
Server crashes
Crash Log [crash-2024-10-30_18.29.47-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17576935/crash-2024-10-30_18.29.47-server.txt)
My server is on Forge 1.18.2 (Windows 11 Computer)

[comment by Qelifern (owner)]
Forge version is no longer in development
